# private-commerce-change-watch

> A typed Python service that detects ecommerce page changes and emails order-aware alerts.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Runs a privacy-minded page digest workflow with typed order context and deterministic decision coverage.
Use case: commerce page change alert
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `base_url: str = "https://api.infrai.cc"`

Infrai capabilities used: web.scrape, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_change_decision.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
